input.content:
# Queue configuration

| Setting | Default | Valid range | Behavior |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `visibilitySeconds` | 45 | 5–600 | Time before an unacknowledged job is visible again |
| `maxAttempts` | 3 | 1–8 | Includes the first delivery attempt |
| `backoffMs` | 400 | 100–5000 | Base delay between retry attempts |
| `deadLetterAfter` | 8 | 1–20 | Failed jobs moved to the dead-letter queue |

- `maxAttempts` counts the initial delivery.
- A value of `1` disables retries.
- Authentication errors (`401` and `403`) are never retried, even when `maxAttempts` is greater than one.

```yaml
queue:
  maxAttempts: 4
  backoffMs: 800
```

- Configuration changes take effect after the worker restarts.
- `visibilitySeconds` is measured in seconds.
- `backoffMs` is measured in milliseconds.

input.description: Capture audit and verify exit codes

input.command:
python3 -I -c "
import re
def toks(p):
    out=[]
    for line in open(p, encoding='utf-8'):
        s=line.rstrip('\n')
        s=re.sub(r'^-\s+','',s) if s.startswith('- ') else s
        if s.strip(): out.extend(s.split())
    return out
a=toks('input.md'); b=toks('output.md')
from collections import Counter
ca,cb=Counter(a),Counter(b)
print('only in input :', ca-cb)
print('only in output:', cb-ca)
print('same order (ignoring the semicolon token):', [t for t in a if t!='seconds;'] == [t for t in b if t!='seconds.'])
"

import subprocess, hashlib

"
